stem: Which idea is found in the selection “Say Yes to Exploring Mars” but NOT in the selection “Life on Mars”?
instruction: Use “Life on Mars” and “Say Yes to Exploring Mars” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: NASA scientists are interested in sending people to Mars.

options.label: B
options.text: People might be able to go to Mars and create a breathable atmosphere.

options.label: C
options.text: Scientists are excited about the discovery of frozen water on Mars.

options.label: D
options.text: It would be beneficial for astronauts to visit Mars in the future.
